notes.title: Multiplayer jump and flip fix
notes.content:
[p]Ok so we know about a few other issues that're currently being worked on such as the gittering issue that happens when you're a connected client but we made some major progress in getting the bug fixed with multiplayer, here's what was currently fixed.


-> Connected users can now jump properly and can thus make progress with their friends

-> Connected users can now flip properly and thus can be a bit more chaotic.

->Hosts can now see connected drivers flip and jump properly

->Connected users can now earn achievements properly..... I think? idk I'm just one man and I break a lit of things

->Stopped an issue where the final boss would materialise and send the player to another dimension 

->Fixed the receipt value not showing the proper cost of your unhealthy pizza settings habits. Now we can accurately bill you![/p]

notes.title: Icon Update
notes.content:
Pizza Pup was not getting the recognition they clearly deserve, so now we've updated it to properly show pizza pups face and name.

Oh we also fixed default resolution being an issue.........

oh and we fixed that one bluescreening issue that totally existed beyond the 4th wall.......

and now we're just writing these notes for the people who actually read each induvial small patch note fully, seriously what're you doing here? You're not getting a hint for the secret ending, not until we update the game in a major way, maybe localization or something, until then you just have to figure it out

notes.title: Main Menu Controller support
notes.content:
We here at pizza pups multiversal pizzeria are always striving to push the boundaries of what it means to make pizza, with that in mind we've updated our training simulation

-Main menu in the training simulation now has controller support

-Patched the firewall to better keep out whoever keeps changing employee names

-Changed Nyx's name back from "The weird edgy goth girl"
-Changed Hajime's name back from "Target"
-Changed Sylis's name back from "Grumpy old shit"

notes.title: 4 wheels of controlled chaos
notes.content:
We here at Pizza Pups Multidimensional Pizzeria have heard your concerns and are working on making the simulation as pleasing as possible for all new recruits.

-we've now supplied any employee participating in Pizza Pups Multidimensional Pizzeria Driving Evaluation Simulation with a new model of the Pizza Car that comes with 4 wheel drive

-The simulation is now equipped to handle controller inputs but only when driving, our simulation menu's still require mouse and keyboard for now.

-The "Keep Camera rotation" Option in the menu has been defaulted to off by some maniac, we would switch it back but we're still 52687 pizzas behind schedule

Until more is changed Sylis and Nyx have been very busy dealing with customer complaints so please stop bothering them
